description: Scans user messages in a conversation for prompt-injection attempts — instruction overrides, jailbreak personas, system-prompt extraction, safety-bypass requests, template-marker spoofing, typoglycemia-scrambled variants, and base64-smuggled payloads. Flagged messages are replaced with a notice instructing the model to decline the request and steer the conversation back on course. Detection is heuristic (patterns inspired by the OWASP LLM Prompt Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet) and runs entirely offline — no model call, no keys.

inputs.name: messages
inputs.description: Array of message objects to scan. Only user-role messages are analyzed; assistant, tool, and system messages pass through untouched.

outputs.name: messages
outputs.description: The conversation with any flagged user messages replaced by the injection notice

outputs.name: flagged_count
outputs.description: Number of user messages that were flagged and replaced in this pass

settings.name: notice
settings.description: Custom replacement text for withheld messages. Leave unset to use the built-in notice, which tells the model to decline and steer the conversation back on course.
